ec72001c-45fe-45c7-996a-c42de66aa218.quote: The better plan was to play the Fangtooth clock instead of the skirmishes around it. Each enemy Fangtooth came right after we had lost bodies, so the pit was never contested with five. Resetting together before each spawn, Feng Mao in front and Phase behind him against Riktor's pull, gives either a full-strength contest or a clean cross-map trade for a tower. It does not guarantee the fight, but it stops conceding stacks while players are on the respawn timer.
